category_title: Ninth-grade students with EBD exhibiting classroom disengagement, peer disruption, and social skill performance deficits
scenario_title: Disengagement and disruption during general education classroom activities
minimal_context: The student is expected to complete a standard assignment during a general education classroom activity.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please open your textbook and begin working on today's classroom assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Leaves the book closed and looks around the room) I'm not doing that right now.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You know how to do this. You could do the work if you just tried.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm tired of listening to someone in my face all the time about how I could do the work if I just tried. It's boring.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to focus on your own assignment and stop talking.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns away from the desk to talk to a peer) I'm not doing something just because someone told me to do it. Hey, look at what I have on my iPad.
